english.title: Pilot fail to cause to be produced certificates of registration / airworthiness / licences of flight crew / documents
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the pilot in command of an aircraft, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..), failed, within a reasonable time after being requested to do so by **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), an authorised person, to cause to be produced to that person

(A)_[the certificates of registration and airworthiness in force for the aircraft]_
(B)_[the licences of the flight crew of that aircraft]_
(C)_[documents, namely **(..SPECIFY DOCUMENTS..), which the aircraft was required by article 229 of the Air Navigation Order 2016 to carry when in flight]_
(D)_[documents, namely **(..SPECIFY DOCUMENTS..), which the aircraft was required by a Safety Regulation to carry when in flight]_
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 235(1) and 265(5) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
pilot in command of an aircraft,
failed
within a reasonable time after being requested to do so by an authorised person
to cause to be produced to that person the certificates of registration and airworthiness in force for the aircraft OR
the licences of the flight crew of that aircraft OR
documents which the aircraft was required by article 229 of the Air Navigation Order 2016 or a Safety regulation
to carry when in flight
